# Cluster (Data Source)

A Cluster on the management cluster the provider block names: its phase, endpoint, conditions and the `clusterctl describe cluster` tree.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "capi_cluster" "prod" {
  name      = "prod"
  namespace = "capi"
}

output "endpoint" {
  value = data.capi_cluster.prod.endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Default `default`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) The `Available` (v1beta2) or `Ready` (v1beta1) condition.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) `status.conditions`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `control_plane_initialized` (Boolean) The `ControlPlaneInitialized` condition.
- `description` (String) The rendered object tree.
- `endpoint` (String) API server URL from `spec.controlPlaneEndpoint`.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) `spec.topology.version` when the cluster uses a ClusterClass.
- `paused` (Boolean) `spec.paused`.
- `phase` (String) `status.phase`.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `reason` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
